record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: For the multigraded Hilbert scheme Hilb_{H_r} attached to d general points in (P^n)^r, is Hilb_{H_r} connected, and does every component intersect the distinguished limits-of-points component Slip_{H_r}?

evidence.quote: Problem XXXIII. Is HilbHr connected? Does every component of HilbHr intersect the SlipHr?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $r \geq 1$ and $n_1,\dots,n_r \geq 1$ be integers, and consider the product of projective spaces $X = \mathbb{P}^{n_1} \times \cdots \times \mathbb{P}^{n_r}$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Fix $d$ general points $p_1,\dots,p_d \in X$, and let $H_r : \mathbb{Z}^r \to \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ be the multigraded Hilbert function of the homogeneous saturated ideal $I(p_1,\dots,p_d)$ in the multigraded Cox ring $S = k[x_{i,j}]$ of $X$ (with the standard $\mathbb{Z}^r$-grading).

Let $\mathrm{Hilb}_{H_r}$ denote the multigraded Hilbert scheme parametrizing all homogeneous ideals $J \subset S$ with multigraded Hilbert function equal to $H_r$. Inside $\mathrm{Hilb}_{H_r}$, the locus of saturated ideals of $d$ distinct (smooth) points of $X$ is an irreducible open subset; let $\mathrm{Slip}_{H_r} \subset \mathrm{Hilb}_{H_r}$ be its closure, the "scheme of limits of ideals of points."

Answer the following two questions:
(1) Is the multigraded Hilbert scheme $\mathrm{Hilb}_{H_r}$ connected?
(2) Does every irreducible component of $\mathrm{Hilb}_{H_r}$ intersect $\mathrm{Slip}_{H_r}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent collection of open problems on Hilbert schemes and deformations of Artinian algebras. Related work (e.g., on limits of ideals of points in toric varieties) gives criteria for membership in the distinguished component and classifies cases where the multigraded Hilbert scheme is irreducible, but no general resolution of connectedness or of every component meeting the Slip component for $d$ general points in $(\mathbb{P}^n)^r$ appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Limits of ideals of points in a toric variety
status_evidence.snippet: Criteria for determining whether a point lies in the distinguished irreducible component of the multigraded Hilbert scheme for points in general position in a smooth projective toric variety; applied to classify irreducible cases for products of projective spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist on the distinguished (Slip) component for multigraded Hilbert schemes of points in toric varieties, but connectedness of Hilb_{H_r} and intersection of all components with Slip_{H_r} remain unaddressed in general.

status_evidence.title: Multigraded Hilbert Schemes
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs the multigraded Hilbert scheme parametrizing all homogeneous ideals with a fixed Hilbert function under an abelian group grading.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the parameter space in which the connectivity question is posed.
